mentions.name: Smart exercise bike game suite
mentions.description: A suite of high-dopamine games that use smart exercise bikes as the control interface, designed to make long indoor cycling workouts engaging. The first finished prototype is a marble-sorting game: higher watt output blows marbles upward with wind, lower output lets them fall, and steady output moves them horizontally, with satisfying noise when a marble lands in the correct hole; it rewards steady watt output over time with minor adjustments. Planned follow-ups include a tower defence game and a Kerbal Space Program-style physics game where players design and fly winged bicycles using real weight and watt output.
mentions.problem: Competitive riding platforms like Zwift and Rouvy push the rider to sprint after faster people and ruin longer workouts, and boredom makes it hard to sustain steady endurance training.
